Your pharmacist was on their way to put the finished product in the pass through for use when I stopped them to ask what they planned to do with the product. Your pharmacist then decided to remake the product. In addition, your pharmacist did not perform decontamination and deactivation cleaning steps in the ISO-5 work area after introducing product from the hazardous waste bin. Your pharmacist proceeded to remake the drug product which was adininistered to an immunocomproinised veteran.
